gbifID.description: Unique GBIF occurrence identifier for each record.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, consistently Fabales.

family.description: Family classification of the species, belonging to Fabaceae.

species.description: Recorded plant taxon, consistently Genista germanica.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet data is absent for all records.

scientificName.description: Species scientific name, uniformly Genista germanica L.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship as originally recorded, if provided.

countryCode.description: Two-letter ISO country code identifying the occurrence location.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: Administrative region (state or province) where each occurrence was recorded across Europe.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote presence of the species at each occurrence location.

individualCount.description: Number of observed individuals per occurrence record.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision information is missing for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation data missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data missing for all occurrence records.

depth.description: Depth data is missing for all records.

day.description: Day of month when observation was recorded.

year.description: Year of observation for each occurrence.

speciesKey.description: Uniform taxonomic identifier for the recorded species across all occurrence records.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source type, uniformly indicating human observation.

institutionCode.description: Institution code identifies the data source, consistently iNaturalist for all records.

collectionCode.description: All records are classified under the collection code “Observations”.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field.

dateIdentified.description: Observation identification date and time recorded for each occurrence.

license.description: License type governing data reuse, using Creative Commons identifiers.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each Genista germanica occurrence.

typeStatus.description: No type status information recorded for any occurrence.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means data missing for all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the most recent data interpretation for each occurrence record.
